name: Morty's Cafe Morning Egg, Cheddar, Potato & Bacon/Steak Breakfast Burrito
whyItWorks: Scrambled eggs, melted cheddar, potatoes, and bacon or steak wrapped in a warm flour tortilla make a filling, portable breakfast before heading up Logan Canyon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bacon or Steak Breakfast Burrito with eggs, cheddar, and potatoes only—ask for no salsa, no raw pico de gallo, and no jalapeños.
watchOuts: Skip salsa verde/rojo and hot sauce packets
